doc.title: Dick Griffin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 12, 2024

title: Peace, Hope and Love series and giving away CDs
summary: Griffin describes his red, black and white painting series, his website, and CD buyers paying despite being offered free copies.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Do you do anything on purpose to inspire yourself for new compositions or new visual arts? If you’re staring at a blank canvas what compels you to start?

Well the latest series I’ve been doing is called Peace, Hope and Love for the Human Race. But I’m only using three colors, black, white, and red. And with that combination right there I try to blend those three colors in some kind of art form that shapes and that looks good to me you know. Yeah. So that’s my latest thing. But this piece behind me is “’Round Mid-/Bright Mississippi.” And all of that can be seen on my website, it’s DickGriffin1.com. And — my music and my art. And this last gig I played in Savannah I started to give my CDs away because very few people now have CD players and everything. So I did support that and it was very interesting what happened. “I’m overstocked with CDs and I don’t think I’ll ever be able to get rid of all of them in this day and time because they’re fading out, so I want anybody who wants a CD to come up and get it for no charge.” And I say, “When I do sell them it’s for 20 bucks.” And do you know the majority of the people came up and gave 20 bucks, I even sometimes as much, and it was just a handful of people I gave them for free.

Yeah because a lot of people they don’t have the money. They want the CD but they don’t have the money. And it was so interesting, a guy came up and he had a friend upstairs, and he said, “My friend wondered if you took credit cards.” I said, “Yeah, I can do that, I have a Venmo account but if the lady wants it just come down and I’ll give it to © Fillius Jazz Archive -19-
her.” I mean you know if she didn’t have that I’d take a check or whatever, just give it to her.
